pm_exper_user_4573_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.all_options:
(a) Why not set up a 'build-your-own spicy curry wrap' station with fillings such as paneer butter masala, spicy Goan prawn curry, and keema matar? It’s interactive, fun, and lets your love for rich, spiced Indian flavors shine through.
(b) You could wow your guests with a fiery array of dishes like chicken tikka masala sliders, lamb rogan josh skewers, and a smoky, spicy vindaloo chili pot—all inspired by your love for bold Indian curries. These will add vibrant color and heat to your backyard party spread.
(c) You could impress your guests with a mix of crowd-pleasers like gourmet sliders, grilled vegetable skewers with herb marinades, and a tangy citrus punch. These eclectic flavors will keep everyone engaged and talking throughout the party.
(d) Serve up a creative fusion menu featuring spicy curry-infused grilled chicken wings, masala corn on the cob, and mini naan pizzas topped with hot and tangy chicken curry. This will blend your passion for curries with crowd-pleasing outdoor fare.
